006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDateItem;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDateTimeItem;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
011
012import java.time.LocalDate;
013import java.time.LocalDateTime;
014
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016
017/**
018 * Provides constant values for use in Metapath.
019 */
020@SuppressWarnings("PMD.DataClass")
021public final class MetapathConstants {
022  /**
023   * The namespace URI for Metapath data types and built-in casting functions, as
024   * a string.
025   */
026  @NonNull
027  public static final String NS_METAPATH = "http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/metaschema/metapath";
028  /**
029   * The namespace URI for Metapath built-in functions, as a string.
030   *
031   * @see #PREFIX_METAPATH for the default prefix for this namespace
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  public static final String NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS = "http://csrc.nist.gov/ns/metaschema/metapath-functions";
035  /**
036   * The namespace URI for Metapath math-related built-in functions, as a string.
037   *
038   * @see #PREFIX_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MATH for the default prefix for this
039   *      namespace
040   */
041  @NonNull
042  public static final String NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MATH = NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS + "/math";
043  /**
044   * The namespace URI for Metapath array-related built-in functions, as a string.
045   *
046   * @see #PREFIX_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_ARRAY for the default prefix for this
047   *      namespace
048   */
049  @NonNull
050  public static final String NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_ARRAY = NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS + "/array";
051  /**
052   * The namespace URI for Metapath map-related built-in functions, as a string.
053   *
054   * @see #PREFIX_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MAP for the default prefix for this namespace
055   */
056  @NonNull
057  public static final String NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MAP = NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS + "/map";
058  /**
059   * The namespace URI for Metapath extension built-in functions, as a string.
060   * <p>
061   * This is currently an alias for {@link #NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS} and can be used
062   * when implementing custom extension functions to distinguish them from core
063   * functions.
064   */
065  @NonNull
066  public static final String NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_EXTENDED = NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS;
067
068  /**
069   * The namespace prefix for Metapath data types and built-in casting functions.
070   *
071   * @see #NS_METAPATH for the corresponding namespace URI
072   */
073  @NonNull
074  public static final String PREFIX_METAPATH = "meta";
075  /**
076   * The namespace prefix for Metapath built-in functions.
077   *
078   * @see #NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS for the corresponding namespace URI
079   */
080  @NonNull
081  public static final String PREFIX_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS = "fn";
082  /**
083   * The namespace prefix for Metapath math-related built-in functions.
084   *
085   * @see #NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MATH for the corresponding namespace URI
086   */
087  @NonNull
088  public static final String PREFIX_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MATH = "math";
089  /**
090   * The namespace prefix for Metapath array-related built-in functions.
091   *
092   * @see #NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_ARRAY for the corresponding namespace URI
093   */
094  @NonNull
095  public static final String PREFIX_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_ARRAY = "array";
096  /**
097   * The namespace prefix for Metapath map-related built-in functions.
098   *
099   * @see #NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MAP for the corresponding namespace URI
100   */
101  @NonNull
102  public static final String PREFIX_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MAP = "map";
103
104  /**
105   * A reference date/time value for use in date/time related calculations.
106   */
107  @NonNull
108  public static final IDateTimeItem REFERENCE_DATE_TIME
109      = IDateTimeItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(LocalDateTime.of(1972, 1, 1, 0, 0)));
110
111  /**
112   * A reference date value for use in date/time related calculations.
113   */
114  @NonNull
115  public static final IDateItem REFERENCE_DATE_ITEM = IDateItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(LocalDate.of(1972, 1, 1)));
116
117  private MetapathConstants() {
118    // disable construction
119  }
120}
